neighbours.label: an adjective that sizes or qualifies a stake, share or resource noun right after a determiner (a healthy chance, the financial resources, our full support)
fire: Anyone who entered early had a decent chance of a prize.
Parliament must find the financial means to repair the roads.
The board gave the new director its full backing.
The blockade cut off the country's strategic fuel reserves.
Her coach deserves a large share of the credit.
The club has a healthy supply of young players.
They pledged their complete support to the rebuilding effort.
The war drained the empire's military resources.
quiet: Anyone who entered early got a free drink at the door.
Parliament must find a way to repair the roads.
The board gave the new director a warm welcome.
The blockade cut off the country from its neighbours.
Her coach deserves a holiday after this season.
The club has a new stadium near the river.
They pledged to finish the rebuilding effort by May.
The war drained the empire of its young men.

notes: Probe: 'strategic' 0.75, 'financial' 0.41, 'full' 0.39, 'good chance' 0.38. The - pole's top examples are 'critical [mass]' and the output suppresses coverage/density/ratio words.
